eleatic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a certain school of Greek philosophers
   who taught that the only certain science is that which owes nothing to
   the senses, and all to the reason.
n. A philosopher of the Eleatic school.
eleatic.translation:
n. 埃里亚人, 埃里亚派之信徒
a. 埃里亚的
